headline: Red Sox collapse at Fenway while Patriots suffer ugly Seattle defeat
morning_brew: Wednesday night was a total disastah for Boston sports, and I am still trying to scrub the memory of it from my brain. The Red Sox choked away a win at Fenway Park, letting the Angels put up a crooked number in the third inning that we simply could not climb out of. Watching Jake Bennett struggle through his outing was physically painful, and even though the bullpen finally gave us a few zeros, the offense just ran out of gas. We are in the thick of a playoff push, and throwing away games like this is exactly how you end up staring at the final standings with nothing but regret in October.

Across the country, the Patriots opened the year with a brutal, punch-to-the-gut loss in Seattle. Drake Maye looked miserable and even admitted he lost his patience, which is a hell of a way to kick off a season opener. Adding insult to the injury, losing A.J. Brown to an ankle issue is a massive blow that has me staring at the ceiling at three in the morning. It feels like we are playing catch-up before the coffee even hits the mug, and watching that offense try to find a rhythm against the Seahawks was like watching a guy try to parallel park a bus on the Pike.

I am trying to look ahead, but damn, this city needs a win to clear the air. The Sox have to stop the bleeding at the Fens tonight, and I am begging them to put this miserable stretch behind us. My neighbor Rick is already deep into some insane theory about why the Patriots lost based on the turf at Lumen Field, and while he is usually out to lunch, I am currently too salty to even argue with him. I need a massive win tonight or I might just stop answering the phone.

news_digest.headline: A.J. Brown believed to have high ankle sprain
news_digest.dans_take: A high ankle sprain for our best playmaker is a nightmare scenario I really did not need today.

trend_watch.trend: Allowed six earned runs over five and a third innings in his latest start.
trend_watch.dans_take: He was throwing batting practice out there, and that third inning essentially salted the earth on our chances.

trend_watch.trend: Finished his season debut by throwing three interceptions against the Seahawks defense.
trend_watch.dans_take: I appreciate the accountability, but watching him heave those balls into traffic made me want to throw my remote through the wall.
